item.tib: snang dgon gyi skor tshad phan yon
item.coloph: snang dgon bkra shis g.yung gling dang / ye shes mthong grol smin grol bon gling gi/ skor tshad dang 'gyur zhes pa 'di ni dad ldan grwa slob rnams kyis yang yang bskal nas snang btsun g.yung drung nyi ming gis rgyal bstan phun tshogs bla brang nas sbyar ba/ dge ba'i 'bras bu mkha' mnyam sems can thar lam thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig gi smon pa bkra shis dge legs 'phel//
